_readme: Controls which LLM provider this app tries FIRST for each area of the app,
and in what order it tries specific Together AI models before giving up.
Edit this file and save it -- changes apply on the very next LLM call,
no backend restart needed (it's re-read every time, since it's tiny).
'providers' is an ordered list -- the first entry is tried first; if it
fails (or its API key isn't configured), the next one is tried. Valid
'together_models' is the ordered list of specific Together AI models to
try, used whenever 'together' comes up in a provider list above. If a
model is discontinued/unavailable on your account, just delete its line
or move it lower -- no code changes needed.
'anthropic_model' is the Claude model id used whenever 'anthropic' is tried.

agent_functions._description: Every LLM call made by Agent A/B/C/D (segment naming, segment descriptions, product rationale, marketing copy, offer explanations, etc.) -- everything EXCEPT the Segment AI chatbot below.

chatbot._description: The Segment AI chatbot only -- SQL generation and the grounded-narrative rewrite.
